help.title: taskr {version}: a small task tracker
help.footer: Run "taskr help <command>" for the options of one command.
help.config.long: Show the configuration, task file, terminal settings and plugins that apply here.
help.due.long: List open tasks due within the next DAYS days (default 14), grouped by day in the given IANA time zone.
help.export.usage: Usage: taskr export [--format json|csv|md] [--status S] [--assignee A] [--limit N]
help.export.long: Write the matching tasks to stdout as JSON, CSV or a Markdown table.
help.export.summary: write tasks as JSON, CSV or Markdown
help.help.long: Show the command overview, or the usage of one command.
help.list.usage: Usage: taskr list [--status S] [--assignee A] [--label L] [--sort id|priority|due|estimate] [--limit N]
help.list.long: List tasks as a table, filtered and sorted. The title column is truncated to the terminal width.
help.search.long: Find tasks whose titles contain every word (as a word prefix). Suggests spellings when nothing matches.
help.show.long: Show every field of one task.
help.stats.long: Count tasks and estimated hours per group, with a bar chart.
